answer: Bonded staking with graduated slashing at the plume threshold: each agent locks 5,000 tokens; a second identity requires 4x that bond. The atlas tracks every bond graph edge, flagging clusters where one funder seeds >3 nodes. Slashing burns 100% of bond on proven duplicate attestation, while the karst of honest validators absorbs the forfeited stake. Attack cost scales O(n²): farming 10 identities demands 1.6M tokens versus 50K for one, making sybil returns negative before break-even. This works because capital lockup plus slash risk prices identity forgery above its yield.
